text: nandasuttaṃ [299] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho nando devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti #1 po. ma. yu. yattha kho ... patteyyanti vadāmīti na dissati . 2 ma. yu. na kho #panāhaṃ . 3 ma. yu. api khvāhaṃ . 4 paññāpemīti vā pāṭho . etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahānīti . [300] accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno lokāmisaṃ pajahe santipekkhoti . aṭṭhamaṃ
